floater.name: prefs_kvtweaks
floater.title: ⚠ S24 ENGINE - ADVANCED TUNING
floater.text: ⚠ S24 ENGINE - EXPERT CONTROLS - MODIFY WITH CAUTION ⚠

slider.name: process_qos
slider.tool_tip: Real Windows process/thread scheduling tier, applied at launch. 0 = Eco (EcoQoS power throttling enabled - background-friendly, lower priority). 1 = Normal (default OS scheduling). 2 = High (throttling disabled, main thread and process priority boosted for best frame timing).

check_box.label: Keep Background Threads Active During Render
check_box.name: run_multiple_threads
check_box.tool_tip: If TRUE, keep background threads active during render

panel.name: card_cache
panel.text: Fast RAM buffer for texture data passively received from GPU. Reduces disk I/O when textures are re-requested. User controls budget, thresholds, and eviction timing. Passive equilibrium system.

check_box.label: Enable KVRAM Cache
check_box.name: kvram_cache_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Enable RAM buffer for texture data received from GPU (reduces disk I/O on texture re-requests)

panel.text: ⚠ Requires relog to take effect. Recommended: 16GB+ system RAM.

slider.name: kvram_ram_budget
slider.tool_tip: RAM allocated for texture buffer - stores textures passively received from GPU (256 MB - 4 GB in 256 MB steps)

slider.name: kvram_soft_threshold
slider.tool_tip: Start gentle RAM→Disk eviction when buffer reaches this usage level (50%-100%)

slider.name: kvram_hard_threshold
slider.tool_tip: Force aggressive RAM→Disk eviction when buffer reaches this usage level (70%-100%)

slider.name: kvram_retention_time
slider.tool_tip: Minimum retention time - textures must be in cache this long before eligible for eviction (0.1-30 seconds in 0.1 second steps)

slider.name: kvram_min_deck_size
slider.tool_tip: Minimum textures in deck (100-10000 in 100 steps). Higher = more guaranteed cache hits before rotation begins.

check_box.label: Enable Debug Logging (Verbose)
check_box.name: kvram_debug_logging
check_box.tool_tip: Enable detailed logging of evictions, queries, and pressure (performance impact)

panel.name: card_notes
panel.text: ℹ️ How It Works: GPU passively sends texture data to RAM buffer → RAM holds for fast re-delivery to GPU when requested → After grace period expires AND buffer exceeds threshold, oldest textures evict to disk. User configures all timing, thresholds, and budget limits. Clean startup with empty cache.

spinner.name: auto_mute_surface_area
spinner.tool_tip: Automatically mute avatars exceeding this surface area

check_box.label: Enable Texture Compression (BC7)
check_box.name: compress_textures
check_box.tool_tip: Real-time BC7 GPU texture compression (OpenCL). Uploads normally, then compresses in the background a few frames later to cut VRAM usage with minimal frame-time impact. Experimental.

check_box.label: Flush orphaned textures on teleport
check_box.name: flush_orphaned_textures_on_teleport
check_box.tool_tip: Evicts textures left behind by a region-change teleport immediately instead of waiting on the slow background cleanup. Off by default -- testing linked this to avatar rendering flakiness and lower framerate in heavy scenes.

spinner.name: ssao_scale
spinner.tool_tip: Base scale for screen-space ambient occlusion effect

spinner.name: ssao_max_scale
spinner.tool_tip: Maximum scale limit for SSAO effect

spinner.name: ssao_factor
spinner.tool_tip: Intensity factor for ambient occlusion

spinner.name: ssao_effect
spinner.tool_tip: Overall strength/visibility of SSAO effect

check_box.label: Enable D3D11 Debug Layer
check_box.name: dx_debug_layer_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: DX_RENDER only: runs full D3D11 state/shader-binding validation on every draw call, surfacing hazards as debug-output messages instead of silent wrong pixels. Real per-draw-call cost - disproportionately expensive on passes with many draw calls (e.g. shadow rendering, which redraws the scene once per cascade/spot light). Off by default - developers only, enable when testing; normal runs should get full performance.

check_box.label: Enable DX Shader Cache
check_box.name: dx_shader_cache_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: DX_RENDER only: caches compiled D3D11 shader bytecode to disk (shader_cache folder) instead of recompiling every shader from HLSL source on every launch. Currently limited to a small allowlist of proven-safe shaders, expanded over time. Use 'Purge Shader Cache' below to clear it if you ever suspect a stale/bad cached shader.

slider.name: jelly_base_alpha_slider
slider.tool_tip: How opaque the jelly-doll ghost's body is - 0 is fully invisible, 1 is fully opaque. ~0.2 is roughly '80% transparent'.

slider.name: jelly_rim_intensity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the glowing edge along the jelly-doll ghost's silhouette. 0 disables it entirely (flat translucent silhouette only).

slider.name: jelly_rim_width_slider
slider.tool_tip: How far the jelly-doll ghost's edge glow reaches from the silhouette boundary - higher values give a thicker glow.

slider.name: ssr_iterations
slider.tool_tip: Number of ray marching steps. Higher = better quality but lower performance.

slider.name: ssr_ray_step
slider.tool_tip: Step size for ray marching. Larger = longer distance, less accuracy.

slider.name: ssr_dist_bias
slider.tool_tip: Bias to apply when rejecting samples based on distance.

slider.name: ssr_glossy_samples
slider.tool_tip: Samples for glossy reflections. Higher = smoother but slower.

spinner.name: ssr_adaptive_mult
spinner.tool_tip: Multiplier for adaptive ray step sizing. Higher = faster but less accurate.

spinner.name: ssr_gloss_threshold
spinner.tool_tip: Minimum glossiness before SSR engages. Lower = more surfaces get real screen-space reflections, but pulls in far more ordinary (non-mirror) geometry and costs more GPU time. Separate from the reflection probe gate on the Materials tab, which affects probes, not SSR.

slider.name: ssr_depth_reject_slider
slider.tool_tip: Rejects screen-space reflection hits closer than this depth bias.

slider.name: ssr_miss_fill_slider
slider.tool_tip: Probe reflection kept where SSR misses. 0 = none, 1 = full probe. Hits always replace it.

panel.name: card_water
panel.text: Overrides the global SSR settings for water surfaces.

slider.name: water_ssr_iterations
slider.tool_tip: Ray march iterations for water. Lower than global SSR to improve water performance. Set to 0 to disable water SSR.

slider.name: water_ssr_raystep
slider.tool_tip: Step size for water reflections. Adjust to balance distance vs accuracy.

slider.name: water_metallic
slider.tool_tip: Controls water metallicness. 1.0=fully reflective metal-like, 0.35=minimum (lower values cause whiteout). HARDCODED as 1.0 in stock viewer!

slider.name: water_roughness_override
slider.tool_tip: Direct roughness control. 0.0=use environment blur, 0.01-0.60=override (higher values cause whiteout).

slider.name: water_fresnel_power
slider.tool_tip: HARDCODED as 2.0 in stock viewer! 1.0=soft linear, 2.0=normal, 4.0=sharp dramatic edges

slider.name: water_reflection_intensity
slider.tool_tip: Global multiplier for water reflections. 1.0=default, 0.0=no reflections, 3.0=maximum mirror effect.

slider.name: water_specular_intensity
slider.tool_tip: Multiplier for sun/moon specular highlights on water. Higher=brighter sparkles.

slider.name: water_reflection_warmth
slider.tool_tip: <1.0=cool/cold moonlight, 1.0=neutral, >1.0=warm golden hour. Artistic color grading.

slider.name: water_color_tint_r
slider.tool_tip: Red tint (1.0=neutral, <1.0=less red, >1.0=more red)

slider.name: water_color_tint_g
slider.tool_tip: Green tint (1.0=neutral, <1.0=less green, >1.0=more green). Try 1.2 for tropical turquoise!

slider.name: water_color_tint_b
slider.tool_tip: Blue tint (1.0=neutral, <1.0=less blue, >1.0=more blue). Boost for deep ocean look!

slider.name: water_color_tint_a
slider.tool_tip: Tint strength/opacity. 0.0=no tint effect, 1.0=full tint applied

slider.name: water_wave_speed
slider.tool_tip: 0.5=slow calm water, 1.0=normal, 2.0=fast stormy chop. 0.0=freeze animation

slider.name: water_wind_influence
slider.tool_tip: Blends live simulator wind (Develop>Wind Vectors to visualize) into wave direction/speed. 0.0=ignore wind, use the EEP preset's authored waves only (default). 1.0=fully follow live wind.

slider.name: water_wind_magnitude_cap
slider.tool_tip: Ceiling on how strong live wind is allowed to push wave speed/direction, regardless of how extreme the simulator's actual wind gets. Only matters when Live Wind Influence > 0. 0.0=always treat wind as calm.

slider.name: water_shore_fade_distance
slider.tool_tip: HARDCODED as 60 in stock viewer! Lower=softer beach, Higher=sharper rocky coast

slider.name: water_color_absorption_rate
slider.tool_tip: How fast water tint ramps in with depth. Lower=clearer shallows with a long gradient, Higher=tint appears almost immediately at the shore

slider.name: water_underwater_fog_mult
slider.tool_tip: Controls underwater visibility. 0.3=crystal clear, 1.0=normal, 3.0=very murky. Doesn't affect above-water fog.

combo_box.name: WaterPresetCombo
combo_box.tool_tip: Select a water shader preset to load it instantly

button.label: Save
button.name: WaterPresetSave
button.tool_tip: Save current water settings as a new preset

panel.name: card_style

combo_box.name: sky_style
combo_box.tool_tip: Real Constellations places stylized, recognizable constellation shapes (not precise astronomical data) among the field. Starry Night is a Van Gogh-inspired blue/gold swirl style.

panel.text: (Requires viewer restart - star placement is baked once at startup)

check_box.label: Draw constellation lines
check_box.name: constellation_lines
check_box.tool_tip: Thin dotted lines connecting each constellation's stars into its real shape - a star-chart overlay. Live-toggle, no restart needed.

slider.name: star_glow
slider.tool_tip: 0-1 scales star brightness (normal at 1.0). Above 1.0 fades in a soft colored haze halo that widens as you push it further, instead of blowing out to white.

slider.name: star_density
slider.tool_tip: Fraction of the star field shown. 0.0=nearly empty sky, 1.0=full field. Pure visibility cull, no performance cost either way.

slider.name: star_dust_intensity
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the Milky-Way-style dust band across the sky. 0.0=off, 1.0=normal, 2.0=very pronounced.

slider.name: nebula_intensity
slider.tool_tip: Brightness/saturation of the soft colored nebula patches. 0.0=invisible, 1.0=normal, 2.0=vivid.

check_box.label: Show Nebula Patches
check_box.name: nebula_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Enable soft colored nebula patches in the night sky.

check_box.label: Show Shooting Stars
check_box.name: shooting_stars_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Enable occasional shooting stars/meteors streaking across the sky.

slider.name: shooting_star_frequency
slider.tool_tip: Average shooting stars per minute. 0=effectively off, 4=occasional, 20=meteor shower.

panel.name: card_clouds
panel.text: Extra cirrus and cumulus decks layered over the active preset.

check_box.label: Enable 2.5D Clouds
check_box.name: cloud_layers_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Adds a fast thin high-cirrus deck and a slow big cumulus deck on top of the normal cloud layer, for a sense of depth.

slider.name: cloud_layer_opacity
slider.tool_tip: Opacity multiplier for the extra cirrus/cumulus decks. 0.0=invisible, 1.0=normal, 2.0=very pronounced.

slider.name: cloud_layer_height_skew
slider.tool_tip: 0=cirrus/cumulus read at the same apparent height as the base layer. 1=cirrus reads notably higher, cumulus notably lower. A visual skew trick, not true altitude.

slider.name: cloud_cirrus_scale
slider.tool_tip: Cirrus deck cell-size ratio, relative to the active preset's own cloud scale. Lower=finer/wispier cells.

slider.name: cloud_cumulus_scale
slider.tool_tip: Cumulus deck cell-size ratio, relative to the active preset's own cloud scale. Higher=bigger/puffier cells.

slider.name: cloud_cirrus_scroll
slider.tool_tip: Cirrus deck wind-scroll speed, relative to the base cloud layer's own scroll rate.

slider.name: cloud_cumulus_scroll
slider.tool_tip: Cumulus deck wind-scroll speed, relative to the base cloud layer's own scroll rate.

spinner.name: shadow_bias
spinner.tool_tip: Adjust shadow depth bias to reduce shadow acne or peter-panning

spinner.name: shadow_offset
spinner.tool_tip: Offset shadow projection to fine-tune shadow positioning

check_box.label: Enable Dynamic Cascade Throttling
check_box.name: shadow_throttle_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: When enabled, distant shadow cascades update less frequently when camera is still. Improves performance without visible quality loss. Disable for traditional fixed-rate updates.

spinner.name: shadow_throttle_settle
spinner.tool_tip: Frames to wait after camera stops before throttling activates. Higher values reduce flicker on slow systems.

spinner.name: shadow_bias_error
spinner.tool_tip: Altitude-based shadow bias adjustment

spinner.name: shadow_offset_error
spinner.tool_tip: Altitude-based shadow offset adjustment

spinner.name: max_local_lights
spinner.tool_tip: Maximum number of local lights to render (0=unlimited)

check_box.label: ⚡ HardLight Mode
check_box.name: s24_hardlight_mode
check_box.tool_tip: S24 - Reserves hardware light slots for lights closest to camera and in view. Dramatically improves avatar lighting stability in complex scenes. OFF = Traditional LL behavior (selected lights bypass distance, distant lights can steal slots).

spinner.name: spot_shadow_bias
spinner.tool_tip: Depth bias for spotlight shadows (reduce acne/peter-panning)

spinner.name: spot_shadow_offset
spinner.tool_tip: Projection offset for spotlight shadows

slider.name: local_light_hold_time
slider.tool_tip: Minimum time a local light holds its last visibility state before it's allowed to flip. Smooths residual popping from marginal frustum-edge cases - only does real work when Frustum Culling (above) is enabled. Useful on lower-end systems: cull aggressively for real performance headroom, hold briefly to pay for it with no visible flicker cost. 0 = instant/original hard-cutoff behavior.

slider.name: local_light_frustum_margin
slider.tool_tip: Extra world-space slack added to a light's box radius for the Frustum Culling visibility test above. Larger values make marginal/edge-of-view lights less likely to be excluded. 0 = exact hard cutoff.

slider.name: local_light_min_radius
slider.tool_tip: Floors every local light's effective distance-falloff radius to at least this many meters, regardless of its own authored radius. Fixes small decorative lights (walkway lanterns etc.) requiring the camera to be almost standing inside them before they contribute any light. Does not change brightness/color, only how far away a light starts fading in. 0 = original behavior, no floor.

spinner.name: texture_discard_level
spinner.tool_tip: Force lower-resolution textures. 0=full quality, higher=lower quality (saves VRAM)

check_box.label: Force Full Resolution Textures (Ignore Discard)
check_box.name: force_full_res
check_box.tool_tip: Always load textures at highest resolution regardless of other settings

spinner.name: max_texture_res
spinner.tool_tip: Maximum allowed texture resolution in pixels (per dimension)

spinner.name: texture_fetch_threads
spinner.tool_tip: Number of concurrent HTTP threads for texture downloads. 0=auto-scale (16), 1-64=manual override. S24: Raised from 16→64 max for modern systems

check_box.label: Enable HTTP Byte-Range Texture Fetching
check_box.name: byte_range_fetch
check_box.tool_tip: Use HTTP range requests for progressive texture loading

spinner.name: reverse_byte_range
spinner.tool_tip: Size of reverse byte-range requests for texture headers (0=disabled)

spinner.name: hud_textures_warn
spinner.tool_tip: Warn when HUD exceeds this many textures

spinner.name: hud_oversized_warn
spinner.tool_tip: Warn when HUD exceeds this many oversized textures

spinner.name: hud_texture_mem_warn
spinner.tool_tip: Warn when HUD textures exceed this memory usage

spinner.name: max_bandwidth
spinner.tool_tip: S24: Maximum network bandwidth in kbps. Raised from 10 Mbps to 50 Mbps for modern fiber connections (1.6Gbps+). Recommend 20000-40000 for fast connections.

spinner.name: ack_collect_time
spinner.tool_tip: Time to collect ACK messages before sending (affects network efficiency)

check_box.label: Use Separate Thread for Plugin Reading
check_box.name: plugin_read_thread
check_box.tool_tip: Offload plugin I/O to dedicated thread

spinner.name: plugin_cpu_limit
spinner.tool_tip: Maximum CPU usage by plugins as fraction (0=disabled, 0.90=90%)

slider.name: vlc_eq_band0
slider.tool_tip: 60 Hz: -20 to +20 dB

slider.name: vlc_eq_band4
slider.tool_tip: 1 kHz: -20 to +20 dB

slider.name: vlc_eq_band5
slider.tool_tip: 3 kHz: -20 to +20 dB

slider.name: vlc_eq_band6
slider.tool_tip: 6 kHz: -20 to +20 dB

slider.name: vlc_eq_band7
slider.tool_tip: 12 kHz: -20 to +20 dB

slider.name: vlc_eq_band8
slider.tool_tip: 14 kHz: -20 to +20 dB

slider.name: vlc_eq_band9
slider.tool_tip: 16 kHz: -20 to +20 dB

check_box.label: Show streaming audio metadata
check_box.name: show_stream_metadata
check_box.tool_tip: Display song title and artist from streaming audio (Shoutcast/Icecast) as notifications

combo_box.item.label: Media Plugins (libVLC) - Better codecs, 10-band EQ, Metadata
combo_box.item.name: media_plugins

check_box.label: Enable 3-band equalizer (FMOD engine)
check_box.name: audio_eq_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Enable a 3-band equalizer to adjust bass, mid, and treble frequencies (FMOD streaming engine only)

panel.name: card_vlc

check_box.label: Enable 10-band equalizer (VLC engine)
check_box.name: vlc_audio_eq_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Enable advanced 10-band parametric equalizer with preamp (MediaPlugins/VLC streaming engine only)

slider.name: vlc_eq_preamp
slider.tool_tip: Preamp: -20 to +20 dB

panel.text: Range: -20dB to +20dB per band (0 = flat/no change)

check_box.label: Enable GLTF Support
check_box.name: enable_gltf
check_box.tool_tip: WARNING: Can trigger implicit texture uploads costing L$. Setting is now persistent across restarts.

panel.name: card_mirrors
panel.text: ⚠ PERSISTENT SETTING: May upload textures without confirmation, costing L$

check_box.label: Enable Environment Cubemaps
check_box.name: enable_cubemap
check_box.tool_tip: Master toggle for cube-map-based reflections (water, bump/shiny materials, sky). Applied at launch.

check_box.label: Show Emoji Icons in Menu Bar
check_box.name: use_menu_icons
check_box.tool_tip: Display emoji icons next to menu labels. Changes take effect on next viewer restart.

panel.name: card_beam
panel.text: Crisp line core with customizable particle glow.

check_box.label: Reflections
check_box.name: enable_reflection_probes
check_box.tool_tip: Master toggle - completely enables/disables probe system. Requires shader rebuild! Power user tips: lower Intensity for subtle looks, lower Saturation to remove sky colour indoors, increase Blur for softer reflections, lower Ambient for a darker mood.

combo_box.name: probe_level_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Content in each reflection: sky and clouds, plus terrain, plus water, or everything.

combo_box.name: probe_detail_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Once captures a single time. Static refreshes the static scene. Static and dynamic adds avatars and moving objects. Realtime recaptures every frame.

combo_box.name: probe_count_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Number of cubes held at once. The sky cube always takes one.

combo_box.name: probe_resolution_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Resolution of each probe cube face. Higher uses more video memory.

check_box.label: Parallax correction (automatic)
check_box.name: probe_auto_parallax_check
check_box.tool_tip: Off samples automatic probes by direction only, which reads as infinitely far away.

check_box.label: Box probes
check_box.name: enable_box_probes
check_box.tool_tip: Off stops box-volume probe capture and rendering. Sphere probes are unaffected.

check_box.label: Exclude avatar from Dynamic
check_box.name: exclude_avatar_dynamic_check
check_box.tool_tip: A performance choice: keeps avatars and particles out of the master reflection cube under Static and dynamic.

check_box.label: Exclude avatar from Realtime
check_box.name: exclude_avatar_realtime_check
check_box.tool_tip: A performance choice: keeps avatars and particles out of the master reflection cube under Realtime.

check_box.label: Calibration (debug): swap X/Y
check_box.name: rendercubeconvswapxy_check
check_box.tool_tip: Swaps the X and Y axes of the probe generator. Combine with the flips to test all 8 orientations. Off = current default.

check_box.label: Calibration (debug): flip X
check_box.name: rendercubeconvflipx_check
check_box.tool_tip: Mirrors the probe generator along X. Off = current default.

check_box.label: Calibration (debug): flip Y
check_box.name: rendercubeconvflipy_check
check_box.tool_tip: Mirrors the probe generator along Y. Off = current default.

slider.name: probe_intensity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Brightness: 0=off, 1=normal, 10=extreme HDR

slider.name: probe_saturation_slider
slider.tool_tip: Color: 0=gray, 1=normal, 5=vivid

slider.name: probe_contrast_slider
slider.tool_tip: Contrast: low=soft, 1=normal, high=dramatic

slider.name: probe_blur_slider
slider.tool_tip: Blur: negative=sharp, 0=normal, positive=soft

slider.name: probe_ambient_slider
slider.tool_tip: Ambient: 0=dark, 1=normal, 10=bright glow

slider.name: probe_equalize_slider
slider.tool_tip: Blend toward this probe's own fully-averaged reflection: 0=full detail, 1=fully equalized across all 6 faces

slider.name: probe_opacity_slider
slider.tool_tip: Reflection probe visibility: 100%=fully visible, 0%=fully transparent

slider.name: probe_local_light_cap_slider
slider.tool_tip: Caps local light level while probes are captured. Lower values reduce light bleed into reflections.

slider.name: probe_draw_distance_slider
slider.tool_tip: How far each reflection capture reaches. Not the view draw distance.

slider.name: default_probe_period_slider
slider.tool_tip: Seconds between refreshes of the sky/default probe, which also drives ambient light.

slider.name: mirror_probe_distance_slider
slider.tool_tip: Distance at which the mirror probe is considered by the reflection scheduler.

panel.name: card_notes

slider.name: ssao_irradiance_scale_slider
slider.tool_tip: Strength of ambient occlusion applied to probe irradiance.

slider.name: ssao_irradiance_max_slider
slider.tool_tip: Upper clamp on the ambient occlusion applied to probe irradiance.

panel.text: Tweaks not applying? Purge the shader cache on the RESETS tab, then restart.

panel.name: card_gloss_gate
panel.text: Roughness and gloss are the same value here (gloss = 1 - roughness). This gate sets a window: no reflection at or below Reject, full reflection at or above Accept, ramped in between.

slider.name: gate_gloss_reject_slider
slider.tool_tip: Gloss at or below this value gets no reflection. 0 disables the floor.

slider.name: gate_gloss_accept_slider
slider.tool_tip: Gloss at or above this value gets full reflection. 0 disables the ceiling (same as Reject, no ramp).

panel.name: card_metallic_gate
panel.text: PBR materials only - legacy materials have no metallic channel and are unaffected. Same window as the gloss gate: no reflection at or below Reject, full at or above Accept.

slider.name: gate_metallic_reject_slider
slider.tool_tip: Metallic at or below this value gets no reflection (PBR only). 0 disables the floor.

slider.name: gate_metallic_accept_slider
slider.tool_tip: Metallic at or above this value gets full reflection (PBR only). 0 disables the ceiling (same as Reject, no ramp).

panel.name: card_materials_notes
panel.text: 0/0 = no-op. Reject clamps to zero, Accept ramps to full, smooth blend between. Probes only - SSR has its own threshold on the SSR tab.

slider.name: normal_map_scale_slider
slider.tool_tip: Height-map scale used when generating normal maps from bump textures.

slider.name: spec_exponent_slider
slider.tool_tip: Specular exponent used to generate the legacy (non-PBR) specular map. Higher = sharper highlight.

check_box.label: Widen highlight, keep colour
check_box.name: proj_spec_reliable_check
check_box.tool_tip: Projector lights only. Off = LL behaviour. Enables the two sliders below.

slider.name: proj_spec_exponent_slider
slider.tool_tip: Lower = wider highlight. Only used while the checkbox above is on.

slider.name: proj_spec_lod_slider
slider.tool_tip: Lower = sharper colour at distance. Only used while the checkbox above is on.

check_box.label: PBR: use legacy lobe, not GGX
check_box.name: proj_pbr_legacy_check
check_box.tool_tip: PBR surfaces under projector lights only. Off = GGX.

panel.name: card_legacy_materials

check_box.label: Enable Bump Mapping & Shiny
check_box.name: legacy_bump_shiny_check
check_box.tool_tip: Same control as Rendering Adv. Off disables legacy bump and shiny materials entirely.

panel.text: Legacy shininess (None/Low/Medium/High) and environment intensity are per-object, set in the build tools, not a global slider.

panel.name: card_settings

button.label: Reset KVTweaks to Defaults
button.name: reset_kvtweaks_btn
button.tool_tip: Reset all KVTweaks settings to factory defaults (immediate effect)

panel.text: Resets all tuning settings to defaults. Immediate effect.

button.tool_tip: Clear Chromium Embedded Framework (web browser) cache (restart recommended)

button.label: Purge RAM Cache
button.name: purge_ram_cache_btn

button.tool_tip: Delete all compiled shaders for fresh rebuild (RESTART REQUIRED)

panel.name: card_before
panel.text: ⚠ Restart HIGHLY recommended for most operations, ESSENTIAL for shader cache! Some operations (RAM cache, settings) are immediate.

check_box.label: Enable Ground Movement Smoothing
check_box.name: enable_smooth_movement
check_box.tool_tip: Smooth acceleration/deceleration for walking and running

slider.name: smooth_movement_accel_time
slider.tool_tip: Time to reach full speed when walking/running

slider.name: smooth_movement_decel_time
slider.tool_tip: Time to come to a stop when walking/running

check_box.label: Enable Flight Movement Smoothing
check_box.name: enable_smooth_flight
check_box.tool_tip: Smooth acceleration/deceleration for flight controls - reduces overshoot

slider.name: smooth_flight_accel_time
slider.tool_tip: Time to reach full flight speed

slider.name: smooth_flight_decel_time
slider.tool_tip: Time to come to a stop when flying

slider.name: smooth_flight_fast_threshold
slider.tool_tip: Threshold to trigger fast movement (lower = more responsive)

slider.name: smooth_flight_min_threshold
slider.tool_tip: Dead zone before any movement starts - higher = more damping of initial boost

panel.name: card_understanding
panel.text:
Smooths keyboard movement with analog-style ramping.
Lower values respond faster but can feel jerky. Higher values are smoother but slower to respond.

button.label: Reset Movement Defaults
button.name: reset_movement_btn
button.tool_tip: Reset all movement smoothing settings to defaults

check_box.label: Grayscale
check_box.name: ui_grayscale
check_box.tool_tip: Desaturates every UI element covered by this system, independent of the sliders below

slider.name: ui_contrast
slider.tool_tip: 1.0=neutral, <1.0=flatter/lower contrast, >1.0=punchier/higher contrast

slider.name: ui_shine
slider.tool_tip: Fixed diagonal glass-sheen highlight overlay. 0=off, 1.0=strongest

slider.name: ui_hue_floaters
slider.tool_tip: Floater window chrome, panel backgrounds (notification toasts, volume/pulldown panels), title bars, resize handles

slider.name: ui_hue_menus
slider.tool_tip: Menu bar and pie (radial) menu backgrounds, chiclet flash, system well. Toolbar button icons are under Controls, not here.

slider.name: ui_hue_controls
slider.tool_tip: Buttons, toolbar & CHUI icons, sliders, scrollbars, progress bars, color swatches. Avatar/RL profile photos are always protected.

slider.name: ui_hue_text
slider.tool_tip: Chat/IM text, nametags, tooltip & notification text colors (notification backgrounds are under Floaters)

slider.name: ui_hue_inventory
slider.tool_tip: Inventory panel colors, folder & item type icons, filters, outfit gallery

slider.name: ui_hue_map
slider.tool_tip: Minimap, beacons, pathfinding, selection silhouettes

slider.name: ui_hue_script
slider.tool_tip: Script editor background and syntax highlighting

slider.name: ui_hue_misc
slider.tool_tip: Login screen and any other flat UI color not covered by the categories above

button.label: Reset UI Hue Defaults
button.name: reset_ui_hue_btn
button.tool_tip: Reset all UI hue-shift categories to 0 (skin default)

combo_box.name: UIHueProfileCombo
combo_box.tool_tip: Select a saved UI hue color profile to load it instantly

button.label: Save
button.name: UIHueProfileSave
button.tool_tip: Save the current hue sliders as a new color profile

panel.name: card_empty1
panel.text: Rotates each category's own colors around the hue wheel independently. 0=skin default. Pure white/gray/black elements are unaffected (hue has no meaning at zero saturation).

panel.name: card_sorting
panel.text: Near-opaque faces write depth in both modes. Avatars keep their order.
